routes.name: OBA "Find a Club" embedded Google My Maps -> KML export (THE ROUTE)
routes.structure: The basketball.on.ca/find-a-club/ page (regional tabs: West, Hamilton-Niagara, North, Kitchener-Waterloo, Toronto, Durham-York, Peel-Halton, Capital-Kingston) is a static shell with no club data in its own HTML -- the real data is a Google My Maps map embedded via <iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/1/embed?mid=1jf36n-Sx3O1KSIlSjRcGu-JABLNcyUgo...">. Google My Maps exposes every such map as a plain KML file at the URL above (standard Google endpoint, no auth, works with a bare curl, no custom headers needed -- verified with and without a User-Agent). The KML has one <Folder> per region (matching the 8 site tabs exactly) and one <Placemark> per club inside each folder: <name> = club name, <description> = club website URL (and sometimes an email), <Point><coordinates> = lat/long. Parsed 187 Placemarks total, zero parsing anomalies (folder names never leak in as fake clubs). This count matches OBA's own public claim of ~175-187 affiliated member clubs almost exactly, so this is very likely the COMPLETE grassroots/rep club membership list, not a sample.
routes.url_pattern: Single static URL, not paginated: https://www.google.com/maps/d/kml?mid=<MAP_ID>&forcekml=1 where MAP_ID=1jf36n-Sx3O1KSIlSjRcGu-JABLNcyUgo. One fetch returns all 187 clubs across all 8 regions in one XML document.
sample_records: Basketball World Toronto (Toronto Region) - https://www.bwt.ca/ | youth@bwt.ca
routes.notes: This is the single highest-value route found. Region breakdown observed: Toronto Region 34, Durham-York 37, Kitchener-Waterloo 11, Capital-Kingston 20, West Region 19, North Region 21, Hamilton-Niagara 17, Peel-Halton 28 = 187 total. About 14 clubs have an empty <description> (no website on file with OBA) but still have a name/region/coordinates. Full parsed list (name, region, website/email, lat/long) saved to docs/research/raw/oba-find-a-club-kml-parsed.json for direct reuse -- no further scraping needed, this can be loaded as-is.

routes.name: OBL division schedules -- per-division Google Sheets (public CSV export)
routes.structure: The OBL schedule page links out to one Google Sheet per age/gender division (19 divisions: U9-U19 Boys, U10-U19 Girls). Each sheet's normal /edit URL renders via JS and returns no data to a plain fetch, BUT the Google Sheets CSV export endpoint (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<ID>/export?format=csv) works with a bare curl, no login, no cookies. Each division's sheet lays out teams as a grid of 'Pool A / Pool B / Pool C...' column headers with one team name per cell underneath (team names typically embed club name + division + coach, e.g. 'Burlington Force U14 Boys (Scully)', 'EY Eagles U14 Boys - Rozario'). Verified by direct fetch on all 9 boys divisions (U9-U17): non-empty team-cell counts were 21/63/88/119/137/174/119/143/89 respectively (~953 team-slots for boys alone across 9 divisions before the fetch loop was cut short by a timeout); girls divisions U10-U19 plus U19 Men were not exhaustively counted but the page structure and per-division Google Sheets are identical and confirmed public.
routes.url_pattern: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<SHEET_ID>/export?format=csv -- one SHEET_ID per division, harvested off the OBL schedule page's link list (19 IDs collected, see notes).

routes.notes: These are TEAM entries (a club can field several across age groups/tiers), so this is the route to reach OBA's claimed ~1,200 rep teams, complementary to the 187-club KML route which gives the club/org layer. Team names need light parsing to strip age-group/coach suffixes and map back to a parent club (most already contain a recognizable club name as a prefix). All 19 division sheet IDs for OBL were collected directly off the schedule page; the same page pattern (two Google Sheet links per division: one Provincial Championship, one Ontario Cup) also exists on https://basketball.on.ca/competitions/championships/schedules-results/ with 18 divisions x 2 = 36 more sheets, all following the same public export?format=csv pattern -- confirmed working on one sample (see Ontario Cup route below).

routes.name: Ontario Cup entry lists / pools -- per-division Google Sheets (public CSV export)
routes.structure: Same mechanism as the OBL sheets: the page lists 18 age/gender divisions, each with a 'Provincial Championship' and an 'Ontario Cup' Google Sheet link. The Ontario Cup sheet sampled (U10 Girls, Division #1, hosted by Pelham Panthers) contains pool standings with team names in a 'Seed / Name' column plus won-loss records and tie-break logic, e.g. real teams: 'Etobicoke Thunder U10 Girls', 'Chatham Kent Wildcats - U10 Girls - Brennan', 'Guelph Gryphons Greenidge', 'Hamilton Transway #1'.
routes.url_pattern: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<SHEET_ID>/export?format=csv&gid=<GID> -- SHEET_ID+GID pairs harvested per division off the schedules-results page (18 Ontario Cup + 18 Provincial Championship links collected).
sample_records: Chatham Kent Wildcats - U10 Girls - Brennan
routes.notes: Not exhaustively harvested (only 1 of 36 sheets fetched to confirm access), but the mechanism is proven public and identical to the OBL sheets. Ontario Cup entries skew toward the same clubs already captured in the 187-club KML list, so this route is best used to validate/enrich team-level detail rather than discover new clubs.

routes.name: RAMP InterActive host for OBA Provincial Championships
routes.structure: Confirmed real RAMP host: obaprovincials.msa4.rampinteractive.com (found via web search snippet showing a real team page: '/team/11238/3766/34008/316225/calendar' for 'MYAA Jaguars U17 Boys'). This is a genuine public site (Cloudflare-fronted, no login wall) that would enumerate every team per division/standings page if reachable.
sample_records: MYAA Jaguars U17 Boys (seen only in a search-engine result snippet, page itself not retrievable)
routes.notes: Both the WebFetch tool and a direct curl (with a normal browser User-Agent, following the http->https redirect) got HTTP 403 with header 'cf-mitigated: challenge' -- this is Cloudflare's JS/browser challenge, NOT a login wall. No account or credential is being blocked; a human opening this URL in an ordinary browser would very likely see the standings page fine (bots/scripts get challenged). This is not something to bypass per the task's rules -- flagging it as a route that exists and is genuinely public-facing, but that a plain fetch/curl cannot retrieve. If this data is wanted, the practical unblockers are: (a) a headless browser with JS execution capable of clearing a Cloudflare challenge, or (b) asking OBA/RAMP for a data export, or (c) relying on the equivalent Google Sheets (see OBL/Ontario Cup routes above), which mirror the same standings data and are NOT behind Cloudflare.

routes.name: OBA site search / sitemap / robots.txt
routes.structure: robots.txt only disallows calendar-plugin action URLs and an ai1ec_exporter_controller param -- nothing relevant is blocked. sitemap.xml (Yoast-generated) indexes post-sitemap1/2, page-sitemap, widget-sitemap, hof_inductee-sitemap, team_ontario-sitemap, team_ontario_coaches-sitemap, category/tag sitemaps -- no club or member directory sitemap exists; club data isn't in a normal WP page/post at all, it lives only in the embedded Google My Maps (see route 1).
routes.notes: Useful only to confirm nothing is hidden/blocked here -- the club directory genuinely isn't crawlable through normal WordPress content, which is why it took the iframe->KML pivot to find it.

routes.name: OBA annual reports / financial statements (PDF)
routes.structure: PDF documents linked from https://basketball.on.ca/about-us-2/annual-meeting-members/ and /about-us-2/. Prior web-search snippet states OBA 'affiliates about 180 member clubs and associations each year' and 'sanctions approximately 400 tournaments' -- a summary count, not a per-club list. PDFs not opened page-by-page in this pass; flagging as a place to double check for a club-count corroboration only, not a name-level list.
routes.notes: Low priority -- the KML route already yields names, these PDFs would at best confirm the total count (~180, which matches our 187 observed).

routes.name: Regional multi-sport associations feeding OBL (Toronto/York/Peel/Durham/Ottawa)
routes.structure: Investigated whether bodies like 'Scarborough Basketball Association', 'Etobicoke Basketball Association', 'Vaughan Basketball Association', 'Gloucester Cumberland Basketball Association' etc. are umbrella organizations with their OWN separate member-club sub-lists (which would mean the KML undercounts). They are not -- in the KML, these ARE the leaf-level clubs themselves (one Placemark each), and the 'Toronto Region' / 'Durham-York' / 'Peel-Halton' / 'Capital-Kingston' groupings in the KML already ARE the regional associations OBA organizes by. No separate regional-body directory exists beyond what route 1 already captures.
routes.notes: Ruled out as a distinct route -- folded into route 1's findings.

best_route: Route 1, the OBA 'Find a Club' embedded Google My Maps KML export (https://www.google.com/maps/d/kml?mid=1jf36n-Sx3O1KSIlSjRcGu-JABLNcyUgo&forcekml=1). It is a single unauthenticated GET that returns all 187 member clubs in one document, pre-organized into the same 8 regions OBA itself uses, each with a name, website/email, and lat/long -- essentially a ready-made structured dataset, no pagination, no JS rendering, no Cloudflare, matches OBA's own ~180-club claim almost exactly. Already parsed and saved to docs/research/raw/oba-find-a-club-kml-parsed.json. For the ~1,200 rep-team layer (finer than club), pair it with the OBL/Ontario Cup per-division Google Sheets (routes 2 and 3), which are also public CSV exports and give team-level entries that map back to these same 187 clubs.
blockers: obaprovincials.msa4.rampinteractive.com (the RAMP standings/team site) is Cloudflare-challenge protected (HTTP 403, cf-mitigated: challenge) against scripted fetches. It is not a login wall -- a human browser would likely load it fine -- but it cannot be curled or WebFetched as-is. Not attempted to bypass per task rules. If this data is specifically needed, it requires either a JS-capable headless browser or an OBA/RAMP data request; otherwise the Google Sheets routes already substitute for it.

The 36 Provincial-Championship + Ontario-Cup sheets and the 19 OBL division sheets were only spot-checked (a handful fetched), not fully harvested end-to-end in this pass -- doing so is mechanical (script the export?format=csv fetch over the ~55 collected sheet IDs) but was left for an actual harvest run rather than this recon pass.

~14 of the 187 KML club records have no website/email on file with OBA (name + region + coordinates only) -- fine for a directory entry, but there's no contact/enrichment path for those without a manual search.
OBA annual report / financial statement PDFs were not opened in this pass; only relevant to corroborate the ~180-club total, not to add names.
